enriched_description: Spherical inflated ball approximately 24 cm in diameter with a pebbled or textured orange-brown leather or synthetic surface. The ball features distinctive black grooved channels (seams) that divide the surface into eight panels arranged symmetrically. The surface texture consists of small raised bumps for grip. The ball has a glossy or matte finish depending on material. Official basketballs have the brand logo and size markings printed on the surface. The spherical shape is perfectly round with uniform panel distribution. The color is traditionally orange with black seams, though variants exist.

Small basket-like baby bed with a rounded or oval shape (60-80 cm long, 35-45 cm wide). The body is woven from wicker, rattan, or molded plastic, with a smooth interior lining of soft fabric. A hood or canopy arches over one end, providing shade. The bassinet may be mounted on a stand with four legs or rockers, or designed as a standalone portable unit. Handles are attached to the sides for carrying. The interior has a padded mattress covered with fitted fabric. The overall silhouette is a shallow, rounded basket with an arched hood at one end.

Long wooden wind instrument (approximately 1.3 meters tall) with a conical bore that doubles back on itself. The body consists of a long wooden tube (maple or rosewood) with a curved metal bocal (mouthpiece tube) at the top. Numerous metal keys and tone holes are distributed along the length. The instrument has a distinctive U-shape when viewed from the front, with the bell pointing upward. The wood has a dark reddish-brown polished finish. Metal keys are silver or gold-plated. The bell flares outward at the top. The instrument is held diagonally across the body when played.

Tight-fitting dome-shaped cap made of smooth, waterproof material (silicone, latex, or Lycra). The cap conforms to the head shape, covering the hair completely from forehead to nape. The edge has a smooth or scalloped rim that seals against the forehead and behind the ears. Silicone caps have a matte finish; latex caps are glossy. Colors range from solid (black, blue, white) to patterned or printed designs. Some models have an inner fabric lining for comfort. The cap is thin and stretchy, creating a smooth, streamlined silhouette over the head.

Large rectangular textile (approximately 70x140 cm) made of absorbent terry cloth with looped pile texture on both sides. The surface has a soft, plush appearance with visible looped fibers creating a bumpy texture. Edges are hemmed with a decorative border or band (often in a contrasting color). Colors range from white to solid hues or striped patterns. The towel is flexible and drapes when hung. When folded, it forms a thick rectangular bundle. The terry cloth texture is distinctive, with raised loops that catch light and create a soft, matte appearance.

Large rectangular or oval-shaped basin (150-180 cm long, 70-80 cm wide, 40-60 cm deep) constructed from porcelain-enameled steel, cast iron, acrylic, or fiberglass. The interior surface is smooth and glossy (typically white). The tub has a flat bottom with a central drain and an overflow hole near the top edge. Faucets and shower fixtures are mounted on the rim or wall above. The exterior may be finished in matching white or a contrasting color. Built-in tubs have a surrounding tile or panel surround; freestanding tubs have finished exterior surfaces on all sides.

Automobile with an elongated body featuring a rear cargo area that extends the roofline to the back of the vehicle. The silhouette is characterized by a long, flat roof that continues past the rear passenger windows to a vertical tailgate. The rear door opens upward or splits horizontally. Side windows extend along the full length of the cargo area. The body style creates a boxy, utilitarian profile compared to sedans. Typical length is 4.5-5.5 meters. Paint colors vary. The distinctive feature is the extended roofline and the large rear cargo volume visible from the side profile.

Tall tower structure (10-50 meters) with a light source at the top, designed for maritime or aviation navigation. The tower is cylindrical or tapered, constructed from concrete, steel, or masonry. The top features a lantern room with glass panels housing a rotating or flashing light. The light emits a powerful beam visible over long distances. The tower is typically painted white or with alternating colored bands for visibility. The structure exhibits a slender vertical silhouette with the lantern room as the focal point at the apex.

Cylindrical glass or plastic container with a flat bottom and a small pouring spout (beak) at the rim. The walls are transparent with graduated volume markings (milliliters) printed in white or blue. Typical sizes range from 50 ml to 2000 ml. The beaker has a uniform diameter from base to rim, with a slightly flared lip. The glass is clear borosilicate with a smooth, glossy surface. The spout is a small V-shaped notch on one side of the rim. The overall shape is a simple cylinder with a flat base and open top.

Tall cylindrical military hat (30-45 cm tall) made of dense black fur (traditionally bear fur, now synthetic). The hat has a flat top and straight vertical sides, creating a distinctive tall, columnar silhouette. A chinstrap (leather or metal chain) attaches beneath the lower edge. The front may feature a metal plate, badge, or emblem. The fur surface is dense and shaggy, with individual hair strands visible. The hat is worn upright on the head, significantly increasing the wearer's apparent height. The black fur has a matte, textured appearance.
